description: A `runtime.concurrency_groups` group defined in the document's own `runtime:` block (a trusted, path-run document) and joined by two tool effects' `group:` -- both still run to completion and land in state identically; the group only ever affects dispatch timing, never the final value (electricity/docs/spec/runtime-semantics.md §7.2, orchestration-reference.md 'Concurrency Limits').
